description: Native date/year validation and monthly repayment deadline warnings. Repayment calculations and tax formulas are unchanged. Apply once: conditional-format requests add rules.
deadlineSemantics: Interest must start by the end of the deadline month; principal and interest must be settled by the end of the full repayment deadline month. Red = missed; amber = outside forecast. Planned loans with no draws are ignored.
